title: 1997 AMC 8 Problem 4
statement: Julie is preparing a speech for her class. Her speech must last between one-half hour and three-quarters of an hour. The ideal rate of speech is \(150\) words per minute. If Julie speaks at the ideal rate, which of the following number of words would be an appropriate length for her speech?

solutions.text:
One-half hour is \(30\) minutes, in which Julie can speak \[ 150 \cdot 30 = 4500 \] words. Three-quarters of an hour is \(45\) minutes, in which Julie can speak \[ 150 \cdot 45 = 6750 \] words. The only answer choice in between these two values is \(5650.\)

Thus, E is the correct answer.
hints: Multiply the minute bounds by \(150\) words per minute
Convert the time range into minutes
